import sys,json,time,traceback,weakref,gc
from pathlib import Path
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import nn
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/wjq/workspace/svdquant-exp/scripts/research')
import wan_native_nvfp4 as wn
from deepcompressor.app.diffusion.quant.quantizer.config import DiffusionActivationQuantizerConfig
from deepcompressor.app.diffusion.quant.quantizer import DiffusionActivationQuantizer
from deepcompressor.data.dtype import QuantDataType
from deepcompressor.calib.smooth import ActivationSmoother
from deepcompressor.nn.patch.lowrank import LowRankBranch
out=Path('/home/wjq/workspace/svdquant-exp/results/research/E007_native_module_smoke.json')
r={'status':'partial','tests':[],'torch':torch.__version__}
try:
 torch.set_num_threads(6);torch.manual_seed(20261002);torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False
 cfg=DiffusionActivationQuantizerConfig(dtype=QuantDataType.from_str('sfp4_e2m1_all'),group_shapes=((-1,-1),(1,16,1,1,1)),scale_dtypes=(torch.float32,QuantDataType.from_str('sfp8_e4m3_nan')))
 root=Path('/data1/models/svdquant-wjq/ckpts/rcm-wan2.1-1.3b-real-nvfp4-s16')
 weights=torch.load(root/'model.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False,mmap=True);scales=torch.load(root/'scale.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False,mmap=True);smooth=torch.load(root/'smooth.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False,mmap=True);branches=torch.load(root/'branch.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False,mmap=True)
 for name,m in [('blocks.0.attn1.to_q',257),('blocks.0.ffn.net.2',512)]:
  quant=DiffusionActivationQuantizer(cfg,channels_dim=-1,key='test')
  w=weights[name+'.weight'].cuda();b=weights[name+'.bias'].cuda()
  old=nn.Linear(w.shape[1],w.shape[0],bias=True,device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16);old.weight.data.copy_(w);old.bias.data.copy_(b)
  ActivationSmoother(smooth[name],channels_dim=-1).as_hook().register(old)
  lr=LowRankBranch(w.shape[1],w.shape[0],32).to(device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
  lr.a.weight.data.copy_(branches[name]['a.weight']);lr.b.weight.data.copy_(branches[name]['b.weight'][:w.shape[0]])
  lr.as_hook().register(old);qh=quant.as_hook();qh.register(old)
  x=torch.randn((1,m,w.shape[1]),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
  with torch.inference_mode():
   orig=old(x);x_s=old._forward_pre_hooks[next(iter(old._forward_pre_hooks))].processor.process(x)
   packet=wn.pack_activation_legacy(x_s,quantizer=quant)
   legacy=quant.process(x_s);dec=packet.decode();assert torch.equal(dec,legacy),'act decode differs'
   wp,wr=wn._recover_saved_weight(w,scales[name+'.weight.scale.0'],scales[name+'.weight.scale.1'],chunk_rows=128)
   new=wn.NativeWanLinear(wp,b,quant);hookreport=wn._transfer_hooks(old,new,qh)
   with wn.native_bypass(new):replay=new(x)
   assert torch.equal(replay,orig),'hook replay differs'
   native_main=new.main_from_packet(packet,mode='native');qdq_main=new.main_from_packet(packet,mode='packed_qdq')
   nmse=float((native_main.float()-qdq_main.float()).square().sum()/qdq_main.float().square().sum());assert nmse<1e-4
   native_full=new(x);assert torch.isfinite(native_full).all()
   print(name,'exact replay',torch.equal(replay,orig),'native main nmse',nmse,flush=True)
   r['tests'].append({'name':name,'tokens':m,'weight_roundtrip':wr,'activation_roundtrip_exact':True,'hook_replay_exact':True,'native_main_vs_qdq_nmse':nmse,'hooks':hookreport})
   out.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
  del old,new,x,x_s,packet,wp,w,b,orig,replay,native_main,qdq_main,native_full,legacy,dec,lr,quant;gc.collect();torch.cuda.empty_cache()
 r['status']='complete';r['peak_gpu_gib']=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()/1024**3
except Exception:r['status']='failed';r['error']=traceback.format_exc();print(r['error'],flush=True)
finally:out.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
